status: experimental governance lifecycle; not runtime activation

states.meaning: Package or pattern has been found.
Provenance, license, assumptions, primitives, limitations, and threat surface reviewed.
Pattern exercised with synthetic or historical non-authoritative data.
Explicit local diff binds jurisdiction, policy, assurance, retention, review, and authority sources.
Local governance approves a bounded pilot; this does not itself grant individual effect authority.
Pattern may structure a bounded pilot, but each consequential effect still requires ordinary local admission.
Institution recognizes the adapted pattern as process/policy structure; runtime authority remains separately evaluated.
New uses blocked pending review; existing evidence retained.
A newer local adaptation replaces this one prospectively.
No new use; historical evidence remains interpretable under original version.

invariant: Lifecycle state can authorize institutional use of a process pattern only through local governance; it never substitutes for effect-level authorization.
